typedef long long LL;
using namespace std;

const LL N=2002002;
LL a[N];
LL ans, sum;

LL solve(LL n)
{
    if (!n) return 0;
    LL j = 1, cnt = 1;
    while (j <= n) {
        j = (j * 10) + 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    cnt--;
    j -= 1; j /= 10;
    if (j == n) return cnt;
    LL best = 1 << 29;
    if (j * 10 + 1 - n < n) best = solve(j * 10 + 1 - n) + cnt + 1;
    LL best2;
    LL i = 1;
    while (j * i <= n)
        best2 = j * i, i++;
    return min(solve(n - best2) + cnt * (i - 1), best);
}

int main()
{
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    LL n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n);
    return 0;
}
